name: Acropolis Isle
frame: map metres, x east, y north, origin SW corner; yaw clockwise from north; hx along the pad's local x

sites.name: Acropolis Citadel
sites.comp: TKTA Citadel with Hangar (Mono, Fixed) + Le Temple 2
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: no pad of either composition exists; 160 x 160 m, a little over the CIS Small Citadel (148 x 153 m) to take Le Temple 2 inside the walls
sites.stake: The CIS regional command inside the old acropolis; from 340 m it sees the whole north-west sea

sites.name: Windmill Ridge
sites.comp: Lessu Outskirts + CIS Flak Crown with GPs (Appalachia)
sites.size_note: KNOWN for the Flak Crown (op 1 pads); the Lessu windmills are dressing strung along the spine either side of it (not a pad)
sites.stake: Sci-fi windmills on the spine power the citadel, with flak among them; blowing the windmills cuts the citadel's shields

sites.name: Sea Cave Pens
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: an 80 x 60 m apron at the cave mouth (a sea work: may stand at the water's edge); the cave itself is inside the cliff
sites.stake: Boat pens in the sea caves under the white pumice cliffs (tunnel 2 of 2); taking them stops the Yard's northern supply boats

sites.name: Lantern Rock Beacon
sites.comp: CIS Big Radio Tower with GPs
sites.stake: The lighthouse beacon guides Yard traffic into the North Narrows; blowing it blinds the Narrows to night traffic

sites.name: Pumice Coast Bunker Line
sites.comp: CIS Metal Trench Line with GPs
sites.stake: Faces the Kastro Strait and Sound Isle; taking it opens the south beach

sites.name: West Cliff AA
sites.comp: CIS Medium AA Base with GPs
sites.size_note: REDUCED: your built pad (2-M3, 197 x 193 m) holds 4 m nowhere within 960 m; this 120 x 110 m pad needs a trimmed composition. Was: REDUCED: the composition's own pad (2-M3) is 197 x 193 m and nothing that big holds 4 m on the west cliffs; a 120 x 110 m pad fits (needs a smaller cut of the base)
sites.stake: Covers the western sea; taking it opens the west air route to the citadel

sites.name: North Cape Battery
sites.stake: Guns on the north cape cover the north sea and the citadel's back slope

sites.name: Monastery Ledge
sites.comp: Zavala CIS Outpost Fixed with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 60 x 60 m (as op 3's Zavala outpost)
sites.stake: An old cliff monastery (Altis chapel dressing) used as a lookout over the citadel's west approach

sites.name: Ridge Power Station
sites.comp: CIS Large Power Facility with GPs
sites.stake: Takes the windmills' power to the citadel; blowing it drops the citadel's shields

sites.name: Quay Fuel Depot
sites.stake: Fuel for the supply boats; it burns when hit

sites.name: Citadel Gate Checkpoint
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 2-04 (a pass-profile pad 48 x 78 m; here seated level)
sites.stake: The road up to the acropolis; taking it opens the vehicle way up

sites.name: Olive Terraces Post
sites.stake: Watches the south-west slopes; taking it opens a covered climb to the citadel

sites.name: Coral Head Pillboxes
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 40 x 24 m on a coral head (as op 3's shoal pillboxes)
sites.stake: Pillboxes on coral heads cover the boat channels through the Coral Shelf
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Coral Shelf Wreck
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 80 x 120 m for two landers side by side on the reef
sites.stake: A wrecked CIS landing craft on the reef, garrisoned; it holds the middle of the reef and fires on boats threading it
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Citadel Gun Park
sites.stake: Guns and vehicles on the north slope; air softens them

sites.name: Kastro Strait Sensor Stack
sites.size_note: REDUCED: your built pad (A1-03, 40 x 93 m) holds 4 m nowhere within 288 m; this 30 x 30 m pad needs a trimmed composition. Was: REDUCED: the Comms Array's pad (A1-03) is 40 x 93 m; the stack top only takes about 30 x 30 m (the array's mast and a ring of guns); air only
sites.stake: Cues the pumice-coast guns onto boats crossing the strait; killing it lets the crossing arrive unseen. Only air can reach it
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: East Bay Landers
sites.stake: Supply landings in the north-east bay; taking them opens a second beach behind Kastro Quay

5-F Acropolis Citadel: up the road from Kastro Quay past the power station, Windmill Ridge and the Citadel Gate (5-07)
the covered climb from the south-west: past the Olive Terraces Post (5-08) onto the summit's west side
5-M1 Windmill Ridge: from the pumice south beach, past (or through) the bunker line (5-01) and up the spine
along the ridge road from the Ridge Power Station (5-05)
5-M2 Sea Cave Pens: by boat across the Kastro Strait into the cave mouth
from above: down from the Olive Terraces Post (5-08) on its road or the cliff path
5-M3 Kastro Quay: by boat to the quay apron in the cove, then the cargo lift and the stair up the cliff
overland from the East Bay Landers (5-14) or along the road from the power station (5-05)
5-M4 Lantern Rock Beacon: by boat to Lantern Quay, then up the hamlet stairs to the beacon
by boat or air to the rock's north and east shores (shores list), then up the slope on foot
